alt: Morning at the western palace. The Rabbit King brushes the red rabbit while the Sky Princess laughs at a cloud.
The same morning under the sea. The Dragon King at his table, goldfish nosing it, his daughter coming up with empty hands.
Samsin annoyed at an empty stake between Bone-Hone and Blood-Flood. The other revival flowers are already up.
The living row: Laughing-Baffling, Crying-Dying in its ditch, Fighting-Inciting, Ruin-Human away from the gate, Kind-Mind opposite it.
A blue Life flower with a gold heart, on a stake with no name, in the far row.
A white Life flower in the west row. The leaves have gone black.
